Live leaderboard

The Dashboard — your live Eurovision leaderboard

The Dashboard is the heartbeat of every Eurovision Games room. It is the always-visible leaderboard that updates in real time — every prediction that resolves, every quiz answer, every duel finish pushes new totals to everyone in the room without a refresh.

What the Dashboard shows

One screen, every player, ranked by total points and updated as the night unfolds. The Dashboard is the single source of truth for who is winning — and by how much.

  • Total points per player, ranked highest to lowest.
  • Live rank arrows next to each player when their position changes.
  • Source split on tap: predictions, quiz, duels won, points stolen, trophy bonuses.
  • Phase indicator — Lobby, Predictions, Quiz, Live Show, Results, Winners.
  • You-vs-leader gap chip — exactly how far you are from first place.

How the four point sources flow into the Dashboard

Your total on the Dashboard is the sum of four live components. Each has its own update trigger and its own cap, which keeps any single mode from running away with the night.

SourceWhen it updatesCap
Predictions (Top 5 + Worst 5)Host enters Eurovision results, or they update automatically500
QuizEach round ends360
Duels — wonEach duel finishesopen
Duels — stolenEach Steal finishesopen

Predictions and Quiz are bounded; duels are uncapped on purpose so that an underdog can claw back the lead in the final ad break. See the full scoring page for the formulas.

When the Dashboard is most active

  • Quiz round end. Sudden vertical jumps as ten questions resolve at once and the standings reshuffle.
  • Live results entry. Biggest swings of the night as 26+ predictions auto-score against jury and televote totals.
  • Live duels. Small but constant updates as challenges fire and resolve in commercial breaks.
  • Trophy reveal. Final stack as Champion / Thief / Duelist / Oracle / Guru bonuses post.

What the Dashboard does NOT show

A few things stay deliberately hidden so the night stays competitive — the Dashboard is a leaderboard, not a spreadsheet of everybody's working.

  • Other players' Top 5 / Worst 5 picks before they lock — those stay private until the host advances out of the Predictions phase.
  • Duel questions in progress — only the two participants see the quiz items; everyone else sees a discreet "duel in progress" chip.
  • Trophy winners ahead of time — Champion, Thief, Duelist, Oracle, and Guru are revealed at the end on a dedicated Winners screen.

Hosting view vs player view

The host sees one extra control on the Dashboard — a phase advance button that walks the room from Lobby through Predictions, Quiz, Live Show, Results, and Winners. Players see the same leaderboard but no controls. Everyone’s totals are identical; there is no "hidden host bonus."
